2609.23925.title: MCPGen: Benchmarking LLMs on Executable MCPWorkflow Development
2609.23925.paper_summary: We study whether LLMs can produce executable workflow artifacts that remain consistent across graph structure, tool implementation, schema bindings, and runtime wiring. In this setting, correctness depends on cross-layer consistency: a workflow may be structurally plausible, yet still fail because tool implementations, schema bindings, or runtime execution do not align. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate these capabilities in isolation or rely on trajectory-level proxies, leaving open whether generated workflow artifacts execute end-to-end. We introduce \textbf{MCPGen}, an executable benchmark for Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflow development. MCPGen contains 100 self-contained MCP projects across 16 application domains and evaluates three diagnostic tasks: workflow reconstruction, tool creation, and backward-compatible workflow extension. We evaluate 11 representative LLMs in a single-turn foundation-model setting, assessing generated artifacts through static analysis, unit and integration tests, and process-isolated end-to-end execution. Models reach 88.5\% on workflow reconstruction, but no model exceeds 57\% end-to-end execution success. Per-tool unit-test pass rates reach 63.8\%, while project-level integration success does not exceed 45\%, suggesting that integration remains a major bottleneck even when isolated tool tests pass.
2609.23925.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究大型語言模型（LLMs）是否能夠產生可執行的工作流程工件，並在圖形結構、工具實現、模式綁定和運行時連接之間保持一致性。在這種情況下，正確性取決於跨層一致性：一個工作流程可能在結構上看起來合理，但仍然可能因為工具實現、模式綁定或運行時執行不對齊而失敗。現有的基準主要孤立地評估這些能力，或依賴於軌跡級的代理，尚未解決生成的工作流程工件是否能夠端到端執行。我們介紹 \textbf{MCPGen}，一個用於模型上下文協議（MCP）工作流程開發的可執行基準。MCPGen 包含 100 個自包含的 MCP 項目，涵蓋 16 個應用領域，並評估三個診斷任務：工作流程重建、工具創建和向後兼容的工作流程擴展。我們在單回合基礎模型設置中評估 11 個代表性的 LLM，通過靜態分析、單元和集成測試以及進程隔離的端到端執行來評估生成的工件。模型在工作流程重建上達到 88.5\%，但沒有模型的端到端執行成功率超過 57\%。每個工具的單元測試通過率達到 63.8\%，而項目級的集成成功率不超過 45\%，這表明即使在孤立的工具測試通過的情況下，集成仍然是一個主要瓶頸。
